item.description: XPENG will formally enter the Philippine market in September, with the X9 seven-seater and L03 SUV coupe set to become the Chinese electric vehicle maker’s first local models.

item.title: Shop Charges Woman Almost $4,000 For Transmission Repairs, Then The Mechanic Tells Her The Work Was Never Done
item.description: Strapped for cash, the owner of the Ford Edge took out a loan to get the repairs done, but the mechanic says he never touched the transmission at all.

item.title: Marcus Ericsson Wins Inaugural IndyCar Markham Race with Late Charge Past Romain Grosjean
item.description: The Swedish driver earned his extension with Andretti Global, signed earlier this month, with a thrilling drive through the field in the closing laps of the inaugural Markham street race.
